caption: The drawing depicts a single armchair with a high, slightly reclined backrest and a sturdy wooden frame. The backrest and seat cushion are upholstered in a deep red fabric, while the upper portion of the backrest, the armrest pads, and the front lower panel feature a patterned olive-green fabric. The wooden frame of the chair is a dark brown color and includes curved armrests and square legs, with small caster wheels attached to the bottom of each leg. The chair is shown in three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right, and occupies the center of a plain, light beige background. There are no other objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Chair
